summary: Minimal, correct guard that clamps a computed CPU count of 0 up to 1, directly resolving the multiprocessing 'Number of processes must be at least 1' crash. Placed after the branch logic so it covers both the cfs-quota and cpu.shares paths; matches the maintainer-suggested fix.

issues.description: Guard handles avail_cpu == 0 but not theoretical negative values; in practice the upstream int() math cannot produce negatives here, so not blocking.
Comment explains the K8s-fraction rationale well; could note it also covers the cfs_quota branch, but adequate as written.
